title: Accepting a Renewal Offer Before the Term Ends — Commercial Natural Gas Supply
content:
A business renews a Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement before its term ends by accepting the renewal offer on or before the contract end date; the acceptance records the renewed term and books the renewal loyalty credit.

## Which offer is accepted

An acceptance on or before the contract end date takes the plan, term and price of the final options notice where the two expiration notices of the expiring term differ.

## When the credit is fixed

The renewal loyalty credit is fixed only after the agreement's most recently posted swing excess line, when its billed amount is above the correct swing excess amount and its correction lookback has not ended, carries its own rebill credit.

## Recording the acceptance: `accept_bizgas_renewal_offer_c0a82e44`

**What it does.** With `accept_bizgas_renewal_offer_c0a82e44` the business's authorized representative accepts, in person, the renewal offer on a Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas agreement whose current term has not yet ended. One call puts the renewed term on the agreement record (the plan, its term, the price per therm, the contracted annual volume, and the first and last days of the new term) and books the renewal loyalty credit as one renewal loyalty credit line, carried as a negative amount on the bill of the new term's first cycle. Afterwards the agreement shows the renewed plan and end date, and the credit appears on the business's commercial gas bill lines.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool. The care agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, giving the tool name `accept_bizgas_renewal_offer_c0a82e44`, which hands it over to the business; the customer themselves, through the authorized representative, then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, using the exact tool name and argument values the agent gives.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bizgas_agreement_id` | The commercial gas agreement number of the site being renewed, as read to the representative from the agreement record by the care agent | Identifier, text |
| `offered_variant_name` | The plan named in the renewal offer being accepted | Exactly one of the six plan names listed below |
| `term_months` | The length of the renewed term, as published for the offered plan | Integer months; 0 only for a month-to-month plan |
| `contract_rate_usd_therm` | The renewal price per therm offered, copied from the offer being accepted | US dollars per therm, 4 decimal places |
| `contract_annual_therms` | The contracted annual volume of the renewed term | Integer therms |
| `new_term_start_date` | The first day of the renewed term | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `new_contract_end_date` | The last day of the renewed term | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `loyalty_credit_usd` | The renewal loyalty credit the care agent quoted | A positive number of US dollars rounded half up to 2 decimal places; booked on the ledger in US dollars to 2 decimal places, signed, as a negative credit |

Values of `offered_variant_name`:

| Value | When it is used |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | The offer renews onto the month-to-month index plan |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | The offer is the twelve-month plan with the basis locked and NYMEX floating |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | The offer is the twelve-month all-in fixed plan |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | The offer is the twenty-four-month all-in fixed plan |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | The offer is the thirty-six-month all-in fixed plan |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | The offer is the twenty-four-month fixed plan with full carbon offsets |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with the keys `status` (the literal "renewed" when the renewal was recorded), `bizgas_agreement_id` (the renewed agreement's number), `variant_name` (the plan now in force), `contract_end_date` (the renewed term's last day, YYYY-MM-DD), `credit_billing_id` (the reference number of the loyalty credit line) and `credit_amount_usd` (the signed credit booked, a negative number with 2 decimal places).

## Illustration of a hand-over (hypothetical values)

The representative runs `accept_bizgas_renewal_offer_c0a82e44` with `bizgas_agreement_id` "BG-AGR-2040", `offered_variant_name` "Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24", `term_months` 24, `contract_rate_usd_therm` 0.6120, `contract_annual_therms` 18000, `new_term_start_date` "2026-02-01", `new_contract_end_date` "2028-01-31" and `loyalty_credit_usd` 90.00. The return shows a status of "renewed", the plan "Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24", a `contract_end_date` of 2028-01-31, a new credit line reference and a `credit_amount_usd` of -90.00.
